title: Aline Griffith on Skorzeny taking over the WCC
summary: JASON tells of Aline Griffith on Skorzeny taking over the WCC, about 1950s at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then she says it was very different eight or nine years after that because Otto Skorzeny came in and took over the operation.

plain: A researcher who goes by the name JASON told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2026 about the journals of a woman named Aline Griffith, which describe a secret operation referred to by the letters WCC. According to JASON, Griffith writes that eight or nine years on, in the 1950s, things were very different, because a man named Otto Skorzeny came in and took the operation over. The episode ties this to a secret society it says sits behind the hiding of UFO secrets.
